title: MJ-120D Check and Correct Desktop Calculator
body_html: Casio MJ-120D is a 12-digit desktop calculator with 150-step check and correct, tax keys, a large display and solar plus battery power. Review and correct earlier entries before the final total; suited to shops, offices and billing counters.

details.description: Casio MJ-120D is a 12-digit desktop calculator with 150-step check and correct, tax keys, a large display and solar plus battery power. Review and correct earlier entries before the final total; suited to shops, offices and billing counters.
details.usageInstructions: Press ON/AC to switch on, enter the numbers and operators, then press = for the result. Use the solar panel in good light or replace the battery when the display fades.
details.dangerWarnings: Do not drop, wet or press hard on the keys. Keep away from small children. Replace the battery only with the same type.
